title: Element names of the interaction item, the append command and the intake result are not in the sources
source: RWB-E2-034 section 12; TSD P3 v3 T-A.1 API-P3-014 and API-P3-015; RWB-P2-E2034-CON
description: The case-scoped interaction read, the append command and the EFS intake result of the interaction ledger are named in the legacy story by Java interfaces and a legacy path under /api/recovery/v1, and the Ownership Map gives the two interaction operations to rwb-source-data. The published element names, physical column names, lengths and required flags of the interaction item, of the append command and of the intake result are not stated in any source read for this work package, so the story uses the field IDs of the Logical Data Model and the element names it states.
evidence: RWB-E2-034 section 12 lists InteractionLedgerWriter.append, IdempotencyGuard.firstTime, EfsContactHistory.outcomesFor and ContactQuery.byKey, and GET /api/recovery/v1/cases/{caseId}/interactions, with no JSON element names; TSD P3 v3 T-A.1 API-P3-014 and API-P3-015 give InteractionPage and InteractionRequest without field lists; the Ownership Map moves both operations to P1.
proposed: Confirm the element names, paths and field shapes in RWB-P2-E2034-CON and the rwb-source-data API specification at contract review; rename in this story without changing a value or a rule if they differ.

title: Legacy occurred-time order and the case timeline page order differ
source: RWB-E2-034 BR9, AC3, AC9; RWB-P3-E2016-CON; REQ-ILG-006
description: The legacy story reads the ledger in occurred-time order with the case sequence on a tie, while the case timeline contract of the wave serves its page newest first. Both readings describe the same list, so the story fixes the sequence of the merged items and the tie-break and leaves the page order of the screen to the case timeline contract; the conflict is recorded rather than resolved by inventing a precedence.
evidence: RWB-E2-034 BR9: the timeline orders entries by occurred time, then by case sequence; AC9: a late EFS row reads before a later Workbench call. The case timeline contract AC-P3-045-01 of FSD P3 A2.45: the items show newest first.
proposed: Keep the occurred-time sequence and the case-sequence tie-break for the merged list and the case timeline contract's page order for the screen, as ASM-B2-P3-010-2 records; revisit only if the timeline contract changes its page order.
